Estacao Ecologica de Aguas Emendadas, about 30 km NE of Brasilia. The divide of the Tocantins basin (Corrego Vereda Grande-Rio Maranhao) and the Parana basin (Corrego Brejinho-Rio Sao Bartolomeu) is located in the reserve. Area cover 10,500 ha.
